STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds; no one speaks.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the low golden sun behind right, backlighting the maize leaves and rimming the hair, the spaces between the rows in soft shadow; warm natural colour with saturated, believable greens; dust drifting in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Maize field): the Maize field 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 2 (character Devendra): Devendra, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 3 (character Suman): Suman, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 4 (character The boy): The boy, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 5 (prop Spacecraft): the Spacecraft 100% as in the reference.
Continuity: Devendra is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; Suman is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; The boy is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage.
In frame only: Devendra, Suman and the boy. The edge of the maize field, the rows running away from the lens. Suman kneels at the field's edge, screen centre, near; the boy stands before her at arm's length with his back to the field, the trail of flattened maize running from behind him into the rows; Devendra stands a step behind Suman, screen left, near; the craft lies thirty steps into the field at the end of the trail, far. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: Suman kneeling with the boy's hand in hers; the boy standing before her; Devendra standing a step behind her, his eyes on the boy.
Nobody speaks in this clip: Devendra, Suman and the boy never speak.
Devendra is out to understand where the child came from; once he sees the trail he follows it with his eyes to its end, with resilience.
Suman is out to keep the child's hand in hers; once Devendra moves she looks where he looks, with perseverance.
The boy is out to stay beside Suman; once she holds his hand he keeps it there, with persistence.
Pace: slow and still, one long locked shot on the craft; every shot opens in motion.
S1 0.0-1.8s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the field side, slightly low, slow push-in · Devendra's eyes lift from the boy and travel past him, his look going off right of the lens and up along the field; Suman's plait and shoulder soft in the right foreground.
S2 1.8-3.6s · medium, from behind Devendra over his shoulder, slightly high, static · a trail of flattened maize runs from the boy's back straight into the field; Suman kneeling and the boy standing near centre with their hands joined, Devendra's shoulder soft in the left foreground; the open field beyond.
S3 3.6-6.6s · full, child-eye level from the start of the trail looking along it, locked camera · the trail of flattened maize leads to the dark metal craft half-buried in the earth thirty steps in, its open hatch facing the lens, fine dust drifting slowly past the opening, the hull completely still; nobody in frame.
S4 6.6-8.6s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly low, handheld · Devendra takes one slow step forward past Suman, his eyes fixed on the craft off right of the lens, his hands open at his sides; only the maize behind him.
S5 8.6-10.0s · insert, the open hatch from low in the flattened maize, static · the dark opening of the hatch just big enough for a small child, a thin line of heat shimmer at its edge, earth heaped against the dark hull; nobody in frame.
S6 10.0-12.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from Devendra's side, slightly high, slow push-in · Suman's eyes come up from the boy's hand in hers to Devendra's face off left of the lens, then along the trail to the right; the boy's shoulder soft in the right foreground.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
No speech in S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- No added sound effects: no whoosh, no boom, no impact hit, no riser.
- Only diegetic sound: the characters' voices and the natural sounds of this place.
- No words but the quoted lines, each only inside its own Audio window; outside them no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a word.
